rows.grounds: compound of daṇḍikā, muṣṭi, bandha, and anta; final visarga marks nominative singular masculine
compound of samā, āyasa, and samanvita; past-participle adjective agreeing with the measured part

items.question: What material must be joined at the end of the rod-piece fist-band?
premises: the rod-piece fist-band has an end
the joined piece completes the measurement
items.inference: the rod-piece fist-band end receives equal iron
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation to the preceding measured body-part remains implicit
gender and case of samanvitam depend on the understood noun
items.plain_english: At the end of the rod-piece fist-band, it is joined with equal iron.
